caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a tall, ornate backrest. The backrest features a central, vase-shaped splat that is framed by curved and carved vertical side supports, and a top rail with pronounced scrolls at each corner. The chair is brown in color, showing wood grain detail throughout the frame and back. The seat of the chair is made from woven material, likely straw or rush, rendered in shades of green and beige. The legs are turned and connected by multiple horizontal stretchers, including a central stretcher with a prominent, rounded ornament in the middle. The chair is set against a plain, light-beige background with no additional objects or elements present in the composition. At the bottom right, there is a small handwritten inscription.
title: Chair
